subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------PRIN.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 90 (WAM-32). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names PRIN-INFO; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: PRI-INFO (principle information), AFL-DT (affinity dictates), AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From AFL-DT: RE-ST (restructuralism). From INFO-AF-B: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From RE-ST: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From PROG-CONT: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From ALT-F: PART (participation).
